def setup_gui(self):
        # Main container
        main_frame = tk.Frame(self.root, bg=self.colors['window_bg'])
        main_frame.pack(pady=15, padx=15, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Title
        title_label = tk.Label(main_frame, text="🐾 Digital Pet", font=('Noto Sans', 16, 'bold'),
                              bg=self.colors['window_bg'], fg=self.colors['text'])
        title_label.pack(pady=(0, 15))

        # Pet display area with Breeze styling
        pet_frame = tk.Frame(main_frame, bg=self.colors['bg'], relief='raised', bd=1)
        pet_frame.pack(pady=10)

        self.pet_canvas = tk.Canvas(pet_frame, width=200, height=200, bg=self.colors['bg'],
                                   highlightthickness=0)
        self.pet_canvas.pack(pady=10, padx=10)

        # Draw simple pet (circle with Breeze colors)
        self.pet_id = self.pet_canvas.create_oval(50, 50, 150, 150, fill=self.colors['pet_happy'],
                                                 outline=self.colors['text'], width=2)

        # Status section
        status_frame = tk.Frame(main_frame, bg=self.colors['window_bg'])
        status_frame.pack(pady=15, fill=tk.X)

        # Hunger progress bar
        hunger_frame = tk.Frame(status_frame, bg=self.colors['window_bg'])
        hunger_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=2)
        tk.Label(hunger_frame, text="🍎 Hunger", font=('Noto Sans', 10),
                bg=self.colors['window_bg'], fg=self.colors['text']).pack(anchor=tk.W)
        self.hunger_bar = self.create_progress_bar(hunger_frame, self.hunger)

        # Thirst progress bar
        thirst_frame = tk.Frame(status_frame, bg=self.colors['window_bg'])
        thirst_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=2)
        tk.Label(thirst_frame, text="💧 Thirst", font=('Noto Sans', 10),
                bg=self.colors['window_bg'], fg=self.colors['text']).pack(anchor=tk.W)
        self.thirst_bar = self.create_progress_bar(thirst_frame, self.thirst)

        # Happiness progress bar
        happiness_frame = tk.Frame(status_frame, bg=self.colors['window_bg'])
        happiness_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=2)
        tk.Label(happiness_frame, text="😊 Happiness", font=('Noto Sans', 10),
                bg=self.colors['window_bg'], fg=self.colors['text']).pack(anchor=tk.W)
        self.happiness_bar = self.create_progress_bar(happiness_frame, self.happiness)

        # Buttons with Breeze styling
        button_frame = tk.Frame(main_frame, bg=self.colors['window_bg'])
        button_frame.pack(pady=15)

        self.feed_button = self.create_breeze_button(button_frame, "🍎 Feed", self.feed_pet)
        self.feed_button.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)

        self.water_button = self.create_breeze_button(button_frame, "💧 Water", self.water_pet)
        self.water_button.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)

        self.play_button = self.create_breeze_button(button_frame, "🎾 Play", self.play_with_pet)
        self.play_button.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)

    def create_progress_bar(self, parent, value):
        """Create a Breeze-style progress bar"""
        canvas = tk.Canvas(parent, width=200, height=20, bg=self.colors['progress_bg'],
                          highlightthickness=0)
        canvas.pack(pady=(0, 5))

        # Progress fill
        fill_width = (value / 100) * 196
        canvas.create_rectangle(2, 2, fill_width + 2, 18, fill=self.colors['progress_fg'],
                               outline='', width=0)

        return canvas

    def create_breeze_button(self, parent, text, command):
        """Create a Breeze-style button"""
        button = tk.Button(parent, text=text, command=command,
                          font=('Noto Sans', 10, 'bold'),
                          bg=self.colors['button_bg'], fg=self.colors['button_text'],
                          activebackground=self.colors['button_hover'],
                          activeforeground=self.colors['button_text'],
                          relief='flat', bd=0, padx=15, pady=8,
                          cursor='hand2')

        # Add hover effects
        def on_enter(e):
            button.config(bg=self.colors['button_hover'])
        def on_leave(e):
            button.config(bg=self.colors['button_bg'])

        button.bind('<Enter>', on_enter)
        button.bind('<Leave>', on_leave)

        return button
